name: scamguard-pro
description: Enterprise-Grade Multilingual Cybersecurity Awareness & Real-Time Threat Detection Mobile & Web Platform

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const m={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.ico':'image/x-icon'};http.createServer((q,r)=>{let u=decodeURI(q.url.split('?')[0]);let p=path.join(process.cwd(),u);if(fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())p=path.join(p,'index.html');fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){r.writeHead(404,{'Content-Type':'text/plain'});r.end('404 Not Found');}else{r.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[path.extname(p).toLowerCase()]||'application/octet-stream'});r.end(d);}});}).listen(8080,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('[ScamGuard Pro] Web App running at http://localhost:8080/'));"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync

author: Samarjeet Suryawanshi
